+    def evaluation_order(self) -> Group:
+        """Prepare private qrels in the same opaque, relation-independent order as scoring.
+
+        IDs hash each disjoint record set, never identity or the old view UID.
+        This is idempotent and must run before exporting the aligned qrels.
+        """
+        views = []
+        for view in self.views:
+            key = ["evaluation_view", self.uid, sorted(r.uid for r in view.records)]
+            uid = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(key, ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()
+            views.append(View(uid, view.records, view.identity))
+        return Group(self.uid, self.domain, self.split, tuple(sorted(views, key=lambda v: v.uid)))
+
     def blind(self) -> Group:
-        return Group(self.uid, self.domain, self.split, tuple(View(v.uid, v.records) for v in self.views))
+        group = self.evaluation_order()
+        return Group(group.uid, group.domain, group.split, tuple(View(v.uid, v.records) for v in group.views))

 def write_json(path, value):
     path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+"\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def file_sha256(path):
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as stream:
+        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024*1024), b""):
+            digest.update(block)
+    return digest.hexdigest()

+def query_ap(scores, labels, view_ids):
+    """Per-query AP with fixed opaque-ID ties; independent of input row order.
+
+    Scores and private qrels must share the exported view_ids ordering.
+    """
+    n = len(view_ids)
+    if n < 2 or len(set(view_ids)) != n or not all(isinstance(v, str) and v for v in view_ids):
+        raise ValueError("Distinct opaque view IDs required")
     matrix, truth = np.zeros((n, n)), np.zeros((n, n), dtype=bool)
     indices = np.triu_indices(n, 1)
     if len(scores) != len(indices[0]) or len(labels) != len(scores):
         raise ValueError("Incomplete pair table")
+    if not np.isfinite(scores).all() or not np.isin(labels, [0, 1]).all():
+        raise ValueError("Finite scores and binary aligned qrels required")
     matrix[indices], truth[indices] = scores, labels
     matrix += matrix.T
     truth |= truth.T
     result = []
     for q in range(n):
         candidates = [i for i in range(n) if i != q]
-        ordered = sorted(candidates, key=lambda i: (-matrix[q, i], i))
+        ordered = sorted(candidates, key=lambda i: (-matrix[q, i], view_ids[i]))
         hits = truth[q, ordered]
         if not hits.any():
             raise ValueError("Query has no known positive")

+    def test_blind_alignment_and_ties(self):
+        source = fixture(split="dev")
+        aligned, blind = source.evaluation_order(), source.blind()
+        self.assertEqual(blind, aligned.blind())

+                    for i, a in enumerate(blind.views) for b in blind.views[i+1:]]

+        reference = []

+            ranked_ids = sorted(v.uid for v in aligned.views if v.uid != view.uid)
+            partner = next(v.uid for v in aligned.views if v.uid != view.uid and v.identity == view.identity)
+            reference.append(1/(ranked_ids.index(partner)+1))
